title: Retain the stronger ordinary results
statement: The exact J=2 fixture uses three tests/three tasks and 201 primitive products including retained calls, witness audit and nine solves; selected denominators reach 9973 bits and source entries 3749 bits, not asserted global maxima of every intermediate. In the n=192,m=3,512-task numerical comparison at relative A-error 1e-8: witness+PCG uses 5262 calls/cache 6144 numbers; Gaussian input sketch 6729/cache24576; Gaussian RANGE wins compactly with 5070/cache6144; improved CG 15822; FULL MATRIX wins calls at 576/cache110592 with dense work/storage paid. Timings include common truth checks and simulator low-rank speedups. The online 75-task case uses three directions, six tests, 72 certificate reuses and 885 calls. None is a hardware-independent practical win.

requires: Known coordinates, actual K_t v service, PSD K_t and lambda_t>=mu>0; no useful basis, rank, envelope or inverse oracle is supplied.
Fresh charged random tests/confidence allocations and actual residual operations; component access and a known parameter box are EXTRA affine-family assumptions.
